additional_context: AdverseEvent is in current build scope through active source/fhir.ini entries. FHIR-22994 and FHIR-22995 are listed in the same committee note but concern the seriousness value set and severity/definition/comment changes, so they were not decided in this seed reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was necessary because the authoritative current source already implements the FHIR-22740 resolution.
